Two defects that hid each other, both found while checking `stream_socket_pair()`
against `php -n` 8.5.6.

`var_dump()` of a resource on its own was right, but the same resource inside a
container printed `NULL`. It is not a socket-pair bug: `var_dump([$fh])`,
`['h' => $fh]` and `[1, $fh, "s"]` all fail identically, because
`__rt_var_dump_value` routed runtime tag 9 to its NULL arm — the code said so:
"tag 8 null / 9 resource -> NULL". So a live socket pair rendered as
